name: SurveySparrow
description_en:
SurveySparrow is a hosted feedback platform spanning surveys, forms, customer-experience work and research. Its current homepage emphasizes AI follow-ups, channel selection, contextual micro-surveys and analysis of open-ended feedback. These named AI capabilities are a product family, not evidence that every basic survey account includes the complete AI suite.

The pricing page separates Surveys from CX, Brand, Research, Documents and 360 Assessment. Within Surveys, plan limits include active surveys, users, responses and API capacity. Public free-plan figures conflict in the same retrieved page, while paid subscription amounts were missing from its text view; those uncertainties must survive into a purchasing comparison.
description_zh:
SurveySparrow 是覆盖问卷、表单、客户体验及研究的托管反馈平台。现行首页重点介绍 AI 追问、渠道选择、情境微问卷和开放反馈分析。这些命名 AI 能力属于产品家族，不能证明基础问卷账户包含整套 AI。

定价页把 Surveys 与 CX、Brand、Research、Documents、360 Assessment 分开。问卷套餐限制包括活跃问卷、用户、回答与 API 容量。同一读取页的免费额度互相矛盾，付费订阅金额在文字视图缺失，购买比较必须保留这些不确定性。

core_features.explanation_en: Echo is described as asking follow-ups to clarify feedback.
core_features.explanation_zh: Echo 被描述为通过追问澄清反馈。

core_features.explanation_en: Survey tiers include logic, partial-response collection and higher-tier workflows/webhooks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 问卷套餐包含逻辑、部分回答采集，以及较高套餐的流程与 webhook。

en: Capture contextual feedback and review an AI follow-up before operational use.
zh: 收集情境反馈，并在运营使用前审查 AI 追问。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose the suite and survey tier, clarify the conflicting quota, then pilot a partial response and its downstream workflow.
steps.zh: 选择套件及问卷套餐，澄清冲突额度，再试验部分回答与后续流程。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Quarterly/yearly plan, users, response and API capacity; suite and add-on entitlements separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Paid base subscription amounts were not resolved. Quarterly/yearly subscriptions and add-ons apply; an extra-user figure of $49/month is not the base price. Ongoing free allowance conflicts: 75/quarter in headline/table versus 50/month in FAQ. Trial fourteen days, up to 50 responses. Partial answers count; purchased unused extra responses expire by billing cycle.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未确定付费基础订阅金额。按季度/年度订阅并有附加项，额外用户每月 $49 不是基础价格。持续免费额度冲突：标题/表格每季度 75 条，FAQ 每月 50 条。试用 14 天、最多 50 条。部分回答计量，未用增购额度随账期到期。

sources.title: SurveySparrow: AI-Powered Customer Feedback Platform
sources.research_notes_en: Current AI feedback platform distinguishes Echo, SmartReach, SpotChecks, CogniVue, Co-Pilot and Enrich; claims not independently tested.

sources.title: Online Survey Software Pricing & Plans | SurveySparrow
sources.research_notes_en: Survey tiers and separate suites, partial responses count, add-on expiry, quarterly/annual renewal and contradictory free-plan allowances.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Create, send, understand and assign action
sections.title_zh: 创建、发送、理解，再安排处理
sections.en: The platform describes a create–send–understand–act flow. Echo asks follow-ups, SpotChecks triggers website/app micro-surveys, and CogniVue analyzes themes or drivers. For an illustrative product-exit study, choose the specific question, audience and channel before introducing AI. Review what an AI follow-up asks and compare its categorization with the original answer; no accuracy or conversion benefit was tested.
sections.zh: 平台描述创建、发送、理解和行动流程。Echo 负责追问，SpotChecks 触发网站/应用微问卷，CogniVue 分析主题或驱动因素。例如产品离开研究，应先选择问题、受众与渠道，再引入 AI。需审查追问实际内容，并把分类与原始答案对照；本文未测试准确率或转化收益。

sections.title_en: Confirm the survey tier and the separate suite
sections.title_zh: 确认问卷套餐与独立套件
sections.en: The Surveys cards list one user for Basic and Starter, three for Business, and custom enterprise scope. Basic lists display/skip logic and partial responses; Starter adds translation, while Business lists workflows, webhooks and custom branding. Enterprise names CSS, auto-translation and advanced analysis. The table also contains API limits. Confirm AI-suite and channel entitlements explicitly rather than inferring them from the homepage.
sections.zh: Surveys 卡片列 Basic、Starter 为 1 人，Business 为 3 人，企业范围定制。Basic 列显示/跳题逻辑和部分回答，Starter 增加翻译，Business 列流程、webhook 和自定义品牌，Enterprise 列 CSS、自动翻译及高级分析。表中另有限制 API。AI 套件与渠道权益应明确确认，不能由首页推断。

sections.title_en: A partial answer is still one response
sections.en: The FAQ counts a response per respondent whether the survey is completed or only partially answered. Buying additional responses raises capacity, but unused purchased extras expire with the billing cycle. The Basic, Starter and Business cards display 2,500, 15,000 and 36,000 responses, yet the extracted card text does not unambiguously bind those figures to the selected quarterly/yearly control. Do not label them monthly allowances.
sections.zh: FAQ 按回答者计费，无论全部完成或只答一部分，都计一条。购买额外回答可提高容量，但未用部分随账期到期。Basic、Starter、Business 卡片展示 2,500、15,000、36,000 条，但抽取文字未清楚绑定季度/年度选择，不能把它们写成月度额度。

sections.en: The page’s headline and usage table say 75 responses per quarter, three active surveys and ten questions each. The FAQ instead says 50 responses per month after trial. The trial FAQ describes fourteen days of Business features with up to 50 responses and no credit card, followed by downgrade. These conflicting ongoing allowances require confirmation. Paid base amounts did not render; an additional-user figure of $49/month is an add-on, not a starting subscription quote.
sections.zh: 页面标题与用量表称每季度 75 条、3 份活跃问卷、每份 10 题，FAQ 却称试用后每月 50 条。试用 FAQ 为 14 天 Business 功能、最多 50 条、无需信用卡，到期降级。持续额度冲突需确认。付费基础金额未渲染，额外用户每月 $49 是附加项，不是订阅起价。

sections.en: Subscriptions auto-renew quarterly or yearly. Cancellation takes effect at the current cycle’s end; the page’s general flexibility wording does not establish an immediate refund. For rollout, test one partial response, a logic branch, export and the intended webhook destination. SurveySparrow is worth evaluating for recurring feedback with follow-up, but a verified self-hosted installation was not established. Failure retries, retention and AI data handling remain specific gaps.
sections.zh: 订阅按季度或年度自动续费，取消在当前账期结束生效，笼统灵活性说明不能证明立即退款。推广前建议测试部分回答、分支、导出和 webhook 目标。持续反馈及追问需求可考虑 SurveySparrow，但本次未确认可自托管安装，失败重试、保留和 AI 数据处理仍是具体缺口。

research_gaps: No survey, AI agent, micro-survey, translation, export, webhook, renewal or cancellation was tested.
Official free allowance conflicts, paid base prices, response periods on cards and AI-suite entitlement require confirmation.
Retention, source license, self-hosting, contractual data location and AI-provider data handling remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
